description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ZendeskHelpProcessor, testing its methods for retrieving help configuration, HTTP client, URLs, and handling responses and exceptions.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessorTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class to verify the behavior of ZendeskHelpProcessor methods, including URL formation, HTTP client interaction, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ZendeskHelpProcessor instance and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Tests that getHelpConfigService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetHttpClient
methods.description: Tests that getHttpClient returns an instance of GuzzleHttp Client.

methods.name: testGetBaseUrl
methods.description: Verifies that getBaseUrl returns the expected help URL.

methods.name: testGetSearchUrl
methods.description: Checks that getSearchUrl constructs the correct search API URL with labels.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Mocks an API response with help article data and verifies that getRedirectUrl returns the article URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Mocks an API response with no results and verifies fallback to the default help URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl3
methods.description: Tests error handling when the HTTP request throws an exception, expecting fallback URL.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Verifies that getDefaultRedirectUrl returns the base help URL.
